text: The function extensionality principle (if f(x)=g(x) for all x then f=g) is:
choices: not provable in MLTT without axioms (it must be added as an axiom or derived from interval types)
explanation: In MLTT/HoTT, funext is not provable from J alone. It can be added as an axiom or derived from the interval HIT. In Cubical Type Theory it is a theorem.
